newsitem.title: JAPAN: Akebono to form French brake pads plant.
newsitem.headline: Akebono to form French brake pads plant.

text.p: Akebono Brake Industry Co Ltd said on Monday it would set up a plant in Arras, France, to produce brake pads.
The new plant will start production in April 1999, and will aim to produce 500,000 brake pads per month in the year 2002.

Akebono has yet to decide on a name for the new plant or its capitalisation. The new plant will be a subsidiary of Akebono Europe S.A.R.L., in Gonesse, France, Akebono's sales and development unit in Europe.
Akebono plans to sell French-made products to European carmakers and Japanese makers' European units.
Akebono is owned 16.2 percent by Toyota Motor Corp, 15.1 percent by Nissan Motor Co Ltd and 13.4 percent by Robert Bosch GmbH.
